Battery Management System (bms).reasoning: Aluminum may be used in heat sinks or casing for thermal management and structural support; commonly used but alternatives such as plastics or steel exist.

Battery Management System (bms).name: Epoxy resins
Battery Management System (bms).reasoning: Epoxy resins are used as PCB substrates and for encapsulation to protect electronic components from moisture and mechanical damage, standard industry practice.

Battery Management System (bms).reasoning: Used as insulation or flexible substrates in certain circuit parts; common polymer but alternatives like polyimide or PET variants exist.
